## MSADrawOptions.colorStyle property

Residue or column-analysis color scheme. Defaults to `"DNA"` or `"AA ClustalX"` depending on what the alignment's alphabet looks like — see `detectSequenceType` in `@react-bio-viz/core`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
colorStyle?: ColorStyle;
```
